decisions.decision: Operating budget draft left unbalanced; it goes to the Town Manager as a preliminary draft and the Commission will discuss it at future meetings.
decisions.quote: the commission does not need to balance it now as this is just a preliminary operating budget draft for the town manager.

decisions.decision: The new $12K administration consulting services line was agreed by all members present.
decisions.quote: john pointed out it is a new line for $12k and all agreed.

decisions.decision: Business Manager to raise with the Town Manager whether the ARPA funding requests are included in this budget.
decisions.quote: barb will talk with the town manager regarding having these funds included in this budget.

decisions.decision: Business Manager to discuss increasing the OPEB funding with the Town Accountant.
decisions.quote: barb suggested increasing to $1k and will discuss with the town accountant.

decisions.decision: DPW Director to discuss pump station safety issues with the pump station contractor.
decisions.quote: bill said the safety issues would be for laypersons entering the station and he will discuss this with al.

decisions.decision: Commission to discuss the requirement for a copy of the plumbing permit at its next meeting.
decisions.quote: he suggested the commission discuss it at the next meeting.

budget_items.topic: Expected user charges and deduct meters
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Revenue estimate for user charges and deduct meter fees, with user counts.
budget_items.quote: expected user charges are $1.2m. (927 users), deduct meters - $2,800 for 54 users, connection fees - $17k

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Connection fee revenue estimate, assuming six new connections.
budget_items.quote: connection fees - $17k (assuming 6 new connections)

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Proposed fees for compliant grease trap accounts; non-compliant fees may not be budgeted.
budget_items.quote: she proposed charging $50 for internal traps and $100 for external interceptors if compliant.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Sewer bank money collected last year went to stabilization; I/I remediation is required annually and is estimated at this amount.
budget_items.quote: we are required to spend money every year on i/l remediation and for this budget we've estimated spending $10k.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Payroll is largely estimated; a cost of living increase is included.
budget_items.quote: there is also a cost of living (cola) increase of 3.5%.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Pump station repairs line increased from last year, compared with the amount spent in 2020.
budget_items.quote: in 2020, they spent $47k, so he bumped it up to $20k from $10k

budget_items.topic: Sewer line jetting, manhole repairs, meter pits
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Line items for jetting, manhole repairs and meter lease.
budget_items.quote: sewer lines-jetting increased to $15k. manhole repairs - $10k. meter pits/flow meters - $5,400 for lease of the meters.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Outsourcing line increased for the new O&M contract, which is to be rebid.
budget_items.quote: outsourcing - was increased to $120k for the new o&m contract because it will be a new contract.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Generator maintenance contract with Weld.
budget_items.quote: generator maintenance contract with weld- $7k.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: New line to fund consulting or office cover after the Business Manager retires; agreed.
budget_items.quote: john pointed out it is a new line for $12k and all agreed.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Legal budgeted yearly; may rise if the IMA with Leominster is taken to Town Counsel.
budget_items.quote: legal - budgeted yearly at $5k.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Engineering line increased for 40B questions and pump station upgrades, plus flow meter data work.
budget_items.quote: plus $5k for flow meter data and calibration, for a total of $35k.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Capital set at a figure in case ARPA funds are not received, split between pump stations and manholes.
budget_items.quote: capital plan -was set at $96k in case the arpa funds are not received ($56k for planned pump station upgrades and $40k manhole maintenance).

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Debt service increased for additional debt coming due in FY24.
budget_items.quote: leominster debt service (increased to $56k for fy24 for additional debt coming due)

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Projected usage payments to Leominster and Fitchburg.
budget_items.quote: leominster usage is projected as $520k and fitchburg usage as $220k.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Per-connection payments to Leominster and the Fitchburg connection estimate.
budget_items.quote: barb noted they pay $750 for every connection and is based on 5 residential connections.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Indirect cost transfer from the town accountant, including 15% of the DPW Director's time.
budget_items.quote: barb noted the transfer is $87k and includes 15% of bil's time.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: OPEB funding usually set at a fixed amount since FY19; increase to $1K proposed.
budget_items.quote: opeb funding- usually put $656 since fy19 but barb suggested increasing to $1k

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Preliminary totals: expenses about $2.1 million, revenues about $1.9 million, deficit to be adjusted.
budget_items.quote: total expenses- $2.1 million and total revenues- $ 1.9 million.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The $183K deficit will be adjusted after betterments and debt service are worked through.
budget_items.quote: barb added the deficit of $183k will be adjusted after she works through the betterments and debt service.
